title: Carzaniga-2025-foundation-10.48550/arxiv.2506.20354
description: Long-term pre-surgical intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 50 patients with pharmacoresistant epilepsy, collected at the Sleep-Wake-Epilepsy-Center of Inselspital, University of Bern, in collaboration with ETH Zurich. The dataset comprises about 6672 hours of continuous, fully anonymized iEEG with 460 expert-annotated electrographic seizures. It is converted to BIDS from the public SWEC-ETHZ release and supports seizure analysis and training of foundation models for neuronal activity.
methods_description: Recordings used intracranial strip, grid, and depth electrodes with 16-bit analog-to-digital conversion at 512 or 1024 Hz. Signals were band-pass filtered at 0.5-150 Hz (4th-order Butterworth, zero-phase), artifact channels were removed, and a median reference was applied. Seizure onsets and offsets were annotated by a board-certified epileptologist. HDF5 source data were losslessly converted to BrainVision format with seizures mapped to events.tsv.
